Legal

Privacy policy

Last updated 2 October 2026

This page describes what the Nimbuy website does with your information. It is written to match how the site actually works today, and it will change when the site does.

Who we are

Nimbuy is run by Krishna Kumar T S. Contact: nimbuy@gmail.com. Nimbuy is independent and is not affiliated with Amazon Web Services.

What the free audit does with your listing text

The audit runs entirely in your browser. The text you paste is not sent to us or stored by us. If you choose “Email me the report”, we receive your email address and your score, not the listing text.

What we collect, and why

WhenWhatWhy
You send a brief or join the waitlistName, work email, company, website, listing URL, your message, the offer you choseTo reply and scope the work
You request the playbook or the audit reportEmail, optional name and company, the score where relevantTo send what you asked for, and the occasional newsletter if you ticked the box
You subscribe to the newsletterEmail addressTo send the newsletter
You book a callName, email, time, anything you write in the booking form (held by Cal.com and your calendar provider)To hold the meeting

We use your consent for newsletters and the playbook, and our legitimate interest in replying to enquiries you send us. You can withdraw consent at any time.

Who processes it

  • HubSpot stores contacts and form submissions (our CRM and email). HubSpot may process data in the United States and other countries.
  • Cal.com handles booking, and Google handles the calendar event and the Google Meet link.
  • GitHub Pages hosts this site. Like any host, it processes your IP address and request details in its server logs.

We do not sell your data. We do not run advertising trackers. This site currently sets no analytics cookies. The embedded booking calendar on the Book page is loaded from Cal.com and may set its own cookies; you can open it in a new tab instead.

How long we keep it

Enquiries and booking records: up to 24 months after our last contact, unless we work together, in which case until the work and any follow-up end. Newsletter subscribers: until you unsubscribe. We delete earlier on request.

Your choices

  • Unsubscribe from any email with the link at the bottom.
  • Ask to see, correct or delete what we hold about you by emailing nimbuy@gmail.com.
  • Withdraw consent at any time. This does not affect what we did before.

Changes

If this policy changes in a way that matters, the date at the top changes.
